result.reason: The grant nominally includes Affiliates and contractors, and termination is limited to uncured material breach, but unchanged Sections (c) and (e) still prohibit sublicensing, outsourcing, and access by anyone other than Licensee employees, undermining the expanded grant. The clause also lacks transfer rights for an M&A successor and does not provide perpetual, irrevocable treatment for any paid-up licence. The stale reference to “such immediate termination” creates an additional inconsistency. The edits are otherwise targeted and do not materially disturb unrelated commercial terms.
